text: Gardening is a rewarding hobby that helps maintain a healthy balance between nature and your living space. Composting, which involves breaking down organic materials like vegetable peels and yard waste, is a crucial step in creating nutrient-rich soil for your plants. This process not only reduces waste but also provides a natural, long-lasting fertilizer for your garden. Adding a layer of mulch to your garden beds can further enhance soil health, suppressing weeds, retaining moisture, and regulating soil temperature. By combining composting and mulching, you can create a thriving and self-sustaining garden ecosystem.
